title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find the indices of two different elements whose sum equals the target. Assume exactly one valid pair exists.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
Third line: target.
output_format: Print the two 0-based indices in increasing order.

title: Maximum Element
description: Given an array of integers, find and print its largest element.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print the largest integer.

title: Second Largest Element
description: Given an array of distinct integers, print the second largest element.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n distinct integers.
output_format: Print the second-largest integer.
reference_solution_python:
def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort(reverse=True)
    print(a[1])
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: Move Zeroes
description: Move all zeroes in the array to the end while keeping the relative order of non-zero elements unchanged.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print the array after moving all zeroes to the end.
reference_solution_python:
def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    result = [x for x in a if x != 0]
    result += [0] * (n - len(result))
    print(*result)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array, remove duplicate values in-place conceptually and print the unique values in their original sorted order.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 10000; the array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n sorted integers.
output_format: Print the unique values in sorted order, separated by spaces.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given daily stock prices, find the maximum profit possible by buying once and selling once later. If no profit is possible, print 0.
input_format:
First line: n.
Second line: n space-separated prices.
output_format: Print the maximum profit, or 0 if no profit is possible.
reference_solution_python:
def main():
    n = int(input())
    prices = list(map(int, input().split()))
    mn = float('inf')
    profit = 0
    for x in prices:
        mn = min(mn, x)
        profit = max(profit, x - mn)
    print(profit)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
